lead: An input with suggestions: the value is the text in the input, and the suggestions only help — picking one of them is not required (use [Combobox](/combobox) when it is). The input reuses Input, the popup reuses Select.

in-field.title: In Field
in-field.description: Inside a [Field](/field), it takes the Field's `variant` / `size` and its disabled / invalid state, unless passed on the Autocomplete.
in-field.label: Tag
in-field.hint: You can also type something new.

styling.title: Styling Reference
styling.description: Autocomplete has no CSS file of its own: the input comes from `input.css`, the popup from `select.css`.
styling.popup: The popup and the suggestions, reusing Select's slots
styling.empty: The message when nothing matches, reusing Combobox's slot
